note: The picture vocabulary (docs/contracts/images/README.md, Pictures are drawings). valid: the server accepts them when a pack is installed and a client may draw them. invalid: the server refuses them; client says whether a client must refuse them too (active content: yes; a wrong namespace is only the server's business). theme: themeSvg(input) is output, byte for byte. Go: server/internal/images/contract_test.go; web: lib/api/images.test.ts.
